8c2f9a74e447.note: Creates the certificate table and indexes; no existing object changes.

895974720462.note: Relaxes ck_nfc_tag_locked_at_matches_status (locked_at may persist on replaced/retired). Older code only writes values the wider constraint still accepts.

a7c3e91d2b40.note: Adds nullable artisan.trashed_at and piece.trashed_at (Gestión papelera). Older code never reads or writes them; a trashed record is never published, so older code serves the same public data.
